description: Source code for the net::HostResolver class and related components, implementing DNS resolution and host management functionalities within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: HostResolver::Host
classes.description: Represents a host which can be a URL scheme host-port or a HostPortPair, providing methods to access its components.

classes.name: HostResolver::HttpsSvcbOptions
classes.description: Holds options for DNS HTTPS Service Binding (SVCB) configurations, including feature flags and timing parameters.

classes.name: HostResolver::ManagerOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the host resolver manager, including DNS settings.

classes.name: HostResolver::ResolveHostParameters
classes.description: Parameters for resolving a host, such as including canonical name, loopback only, etc.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::Host
methods.description: Constructor initializing host with a variant of URL scheme host-port or HostPortPair.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::HasScheme
methods.description: Checks if the host has a URL scheme.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme of the host if available.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname component of the host.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetHostnameWithoutBrackets
methods.description: Returns the hostname without brackets if IPv6 literal.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the host.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::ToString
methods.description: Serializes the host to a string.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::AsSchemeHostPort
methods.description: Returns the host as a SchemeHostPort reference.

methods.name: HostResolver::HttpsSvcbOptions::FromDict
methods.description: Creates HttpsSvcbOptions from a dictionary of settings.

methods.name: HostResolver::HttpsSvcbOptions::FromFeatures
methods.description: Creates HttpsSvcbOptions based on feature flags.

methods.name: HostResolver::ResolveHostParameters::ResolveHostParameters
methods.description: Default constructor for resolve host parameters.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateFailingRequest
methods.description: Creates a host resolution request that immediately fails with the given error.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateFailingProbeRequest
methods.description: Creates a probe request that immediately fails with the given error.
